caption: The drawing depicts a wooden object composed of two main parts: a rectangular base with a single drawer and a pedestal structure on top. The base is depicted in a medium to dark brown wood tone with visible grain texture and is fitted with a round drawer knob on its front. Each corner of the base is elevated by ornate, gold-colored feet shaped like animal claws. Rising from the center of the top surface is a turned wooden pedestal, also brown, supporting a circular platform. On top of this platform sits a round, green pin cushion made of a textured material. To the left of the pedestal is an upright wooden spool, likely for thread, with a black filament wound around it, trailing upward to the pin cushion area. The background is plain and off-white with no additional objects or decorations.
title: Sewing Box
